draft.text: You came in because you slipped on ice and hurt your right ankle.
You have pain and swelling, and it feels worse when you put weight on it.
You said you have bruising and discoloration on the side of your ankle.
You mentioned you are unsure if any imaging studies were done besides an X-ray.
Your injury may be related to ligament or soft tissue damage.
The next steps will be discussed.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you slipped on ice and hurt your right ankle.
You have pain and swelling in your right ankle.
The pain is worse when you put weight on it and better when you elevate and ice it.
You also have bruising and discoloration on the side of your ankle.
This may be an injury to the ligaments or soft tissues in your ankle.
The next steps will be discussed with your doctor.
